statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that have persisted despite initial evaluation
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmia
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is clinically indicated
The service is ordered to evaluate these symptoms in the context of diagnosis codes R00.2 and R42
The diagnosis codes are R00.2 and R42
The service was rejected under reason code PR-204
The service was denied because it is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
